cases.title: Defender Cassiopeia: competing emblem holders
cases.subject: traits
cases.original_question: In Defender Cassiopeia boards, do Rengar or Kha’Zix versions actually finish better when they hold the Defender emblem?
cases.question: In Defender Cassiopeia boards, do Rengar or Kha’Zix versions actually finish better when they hold the Defender emblem?
cases.scenario: Cassiopeia carry with Fiddlesticks and six-Defender support, comparing Defender Emblem on Rengar versus Kha'Zix with explicit holder stars and remaining two item slots.
cases.plan: Use exact holder-bound emblem predicates, named one-copy holder guards and carry/frontline investment in compare_cohorts. Discover actual supporting cores and verify Defender contribution counts; inspect alternate cores rather than treating six Defender as a roster.
cases.checks: Sample sizes and mean/top4/win must come from the joint emblem-holder/core cells. Preserve holder upgrades and remaining items, report support-slot changes and both-holder overlap if present. An emblem-wide ranking is insufficient.
cases.limits: Exactly one Defender emblem can be counted by its exact item name; zero other emblem families/global upgraded-board cost cannot be assumed. Rival choices and unseen trait grants are not recoverable from generic unit names.

cases.title: Hunter Camille and Caitlyn as an alternative
cases.subject: traits
cases.original_question: Is Hunter-emblem Camille with Caitlyn a real alternative to Nidalee/Sivir, or does that board mostly fall short?
cases.question: Is Hunter-emblem Camille with Caitlyn a real alternative to Nidalee/Sivir, or does that board mostly fall short?
cases.scenario: Hunter Emblem on Camille with Caitlyn versus Hunter Emblem on Nidalee with Sivir. Vanguard/Coven leads are discovered support conditions, not assumed complete optimal rosters.
cases.plan: Build actual emblem-holder/carry partner cohorts, inspect stars/loadouts and recurring support, verify Hunter contribution intervals, and compare reportable packages at shared final levels/named investment. Keep low-cost three-star versus four-cost two-star versions distinct.
cases.checks: Explain exact support and equipment-slot cost of each package with counts/outcomes. Bind emblems to intended holders; neither item-wide Hunter stats nor independent Camille/Caitlyn marginals answer the joint comparison.
cases.limits: No generic upgraded-board-cost or equivalent-economic-investment predicate. Old 18.2 external snapshots provide no current gold and must not be pooled into the selected scope.

cases.title: Brawler Yi without artifact dependence
cases.subject: traits
cases.original_question: Can Brawler-emblem Master Yi boards finish reliably with normal items, or is their reputation mostly coming from artifact games?
cases.question: Can Brawler-emblem Master Yi boards finish reliably with normal items, or is their reputation mostly coming from artifact games?
cases.scenario: Master Yi carrying Brawler Emblem, ordinary Edge of Night/Guinsoo's as the primary ordinary complement, compared with named artifact complements in the same discovered family.
cases.plan: Discover exact emblem-bearing loadouts and observed Yi/Rengar/Vi/Nidalee or alternate support cores without conflating them. Compare named ordinary and artifact holder trios in shared star/trait/level contexts, and query other equipped items to assess whole-board special dependence.
cases.checks: Separate ordinary Yi items from artifact-free entire boards. Report counts/top4/win and complete package identity, including actual teammates and upgrades; do not use a broad guide-family headline as the exact emblem/star/trio sample.
cases.limits: Global artifact-free eligibility and artifact-count matching are unavailable as direct filters. The strict reputation question needs that prepared partition; current evidence can still compare declared holder packages honestly.

cases.title: Inferno Kha’Zix and the freed Akali slot
cases.subject: traits
cases.original_question: In five-Inferno Kha’Zix endgames, does putting Inferno emblem on Kha’Zix and replacing Akali actually improve the final board?
cases.question: In five-Inferno Kha’Zix endgames, does putting Inferno emblem on Kha’Zix and replacing Akali actually improve the final board?
cases.scenario: Kha'Zix carry plus Fiddlesticks in five-Inferno end states. One arm retains Akali and a third ordinary Kha'Zix item; the other binds Inferno Emblem to Kha'Zix, excludes Akali and uses an actually observed replacement support.
cases.plan: Discover replacement candidates under emblem+Akali-absence conditions, verify candidate conjunctions, then compare each named final package with shared Kha'Zix co-items/stars and tank investment. Verify recorded five-Inferno support and query board_size/level diagnostics.
cases.checks: Account for both the consumed item slot and the altered support unit. State the chosen replacement and actual counts/outcomes; Soraka/Maokai are leads, not automatically optimal. Exact no-extra-slot claims need certification.
cases.limits: No general exact-board-size filter, evolution choice or farm-history data. Package association cannot identify the causal value of the emblem alone.
